notes:
Lead source: inbound from blog + webinar on growth content. Company builds a multi-variant content generation platform for mid-market ecommerce brands. Early discovery; interested in self-serve hosted API. Key highlights and ask: 
- Volume profile: ~200-300k tokens/day initially; expected 3x growth in 6 months. High request fan-out from per-customer templating.
- Cost sensitivity: must keep cost per variant under $0.02; asked for token-level examples.
- Performance: target p50 < 400ms, p95 < 1200ms for short templates (120-350 tokens).
- Functional asks: batching and prefix/prompt caching (re-use product descriptions across variants), want examples of Intelligent batching settings and how Redwood's caching reduces tokens.
- Model preference: open models OK (Llama 2/3 or similar); willing to test smaller variants for cost savings and fallback to larger for quality-critical templates.
- Routing/fallback: want simple configuration to route high-priority templates to higher tier model; fallback to cheaper model if capacity constrained.
- Security/compliance: SMB but want SSO (SAML) and audit logs; retention controls optional.
- Integrations: Node SDK preferred; will evaluate Python later.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable cost metrics — show us the math and caching wins."
- Internal constraints: one backend engineer to implement integration (weekend window).
- Trial progress: used free credits for initial test; seen early latency ~600ms on dev keys (single-region).
- POC scope: 2-week test with 10k variants/day, measure cost/token, latency, and hit-rate on prompt cache.
- Key docs: pricing deck + POC spec linked above.
